nodes.name: Generate idempotency keys and calendar payload

parameters.query: select public.upsert_application_tracker($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'to_apply', 'Added automatically by OpportunityOS on ACT') as app_id;
insert into public.followups(user_id, application_id, due_at, kind) values($1::uuid, $2::uuid, coalesce($3::timestamptz, now() + interval '7 days'), 'deadline_reminder');

nodes.name: Log autonomous action in events timeline

parameters.query: insert into public.events(user_id, stage, level, message, related_ids) values($1::uuid, 'act', 'info', 'Added to application tracker and scheduled reminder', jsonb_build_object('match_id', $2::uuid, 'opportunity_id', $3::uuid));

parameters.content:
## OpportunityOS 04 Act Workflow
Atomically claims action using idempotency key `user_id:match_id:action_type` to guarantee exactly-once side effects. Enforces the action safety policy: tracking, reminders, and notifications are permitted; external application submission is strictly prohibited.
